related.title: 資料庫交易與日誌
related.why: 日誌與原子提交是共同概念
related.whyEn: Logs and atomic commit are shared concepts
related.transfer: 日誌與原子提交是共同概念
related.transferEn: Logs and atomic commit are shared concepts
related.difference: 交易隔離不能替代共識 quorum
related.differenceEn: Transaction isolation cannot replace consensus quorums
practice: 由「失效模型」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「交易隔離不能替代共識 quorum」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From failure model, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "Transaction isolation cannot replace consensus quorums", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.
